definitions.explanation: An honorific term for what a superior or respected person says or commands.

examples.japanese: ご{主人様|しゅじんさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仰|おお}せ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will do as my master instructs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦なり→なり：09883_nari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{仰|おお}せ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me whatever you need.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仰|おお}せです⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧しか⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since it's the president's order, we have no choice but to comply.

notes:
REGISTER:
Very formal/honorific language (⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧). Used to refer to instructions or words from superiors, royalty, or highly respected individuals.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仰|おお}せ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ - as you say/command
- {仰|おお}せ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ - please tell me
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦なり→なり：09883_nari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{仰|おお}せ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ - please tell me anything you need
- ご{仰|おお}せ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま - as you wish

RELATED WORDS:
- {仰|おっしゃ}る - to say (honorific verb form)
- ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧ - order, command (neutral)
- ご⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧ - instruction (polite)
